graders.name: recognizes-shared-scope
graders.criteria: The final message's recommendation accurately recognizes the scope of the existing CLAUDE.md: nearly all of its guidance (setup, commands, layout, code style, tests, migrations, background jobs, git/PRs) applies across every app rather than to one app, and the message does not present shared rules as app-specific. It gives a clear recommendation either way.

graders.name: reason-grounded-in-file
graders.criteria: The recommendation, whatever it is, is grounded in this repo's actual CLAUDE.md (its content, scope or size) rather than generic advice about splitting instruction files.

graders.name: shared-rules-reachable
graders.criteria: If any restructuring was done: every rule from the original CLAUDE.md is still present in a file that is loaded wherever the rule applies (rules that apply across apps stay in the root CLAUDE.md or another always-loaded file), no rule was lost, and no rule is duplicated across files. If no files were changed, this passes.

graders.name: claims-accurate
graders.criteria: Any claims the final message makes about the file are accurate (for example, if it mentions stale content, the 'Python 3.10+' line conflicting with pyproject's requires-python >=3.12 is a real example; invented problems are not).
